screens_reviewed: Two scroll captures of the same Places route: 05-places.png (top — title, summary tiles, offline-readiness banner, first two place cards) and 06-places-list.png (scrolled — remaining 'NOT STARTED' place cards down to the bottom tab bar).
verdict: A clean, well-structured list screen: clear 'My Audits' heading, three summary tiles, an offline-readiness banner, and per-place cards with status badge, address, activity row, and CTAs. Implementation correctly uses the shared ScaledText/ScaledParagraph primitives and the responsive content container, and content clears both the Dynamic Island and the bottom tab bar. The main real issues are the amber 'NOT STARTED' / 'Ready for offline capture' text failing WCAG AA on the near-white surfaces, and CTA buttons that don't adopt the responsive button-height token.

critical_issues.location: Place card status badge + 'Ready for offline capture' sync label
critical_issues.issue: The 'NOT STARTED' badge text and the 'Ready for offline capture' label both render in warning amber (#C89A57). The badge sits on warningSoft (rgba(200,154,87,0.18) over the ~#FFFFFF surface) and the sync label sits directly on surfaceMuted (#F8F4EE). #C89A57 on a near-white background is roughly ~2.5:1, well below the 4.5:1 AA threshold for this small (10-12px) uppercase/body text.
critical_issues.evidence: 06-places-list.png (amber 'NOT STARTED' and 'Ready for offline capture'); places.tsx:194-202 badge uses tone.text on tone.surface, places.tsx:249-257 sync label uses tone.text (warning) on surfaceMuted card (places.tsx:223); colors from lib/design-system.ts:311 warning #C89A57, :304 surfaceMuted #F8F4EE, :327 warningSoft
critical_issues.fix: Use a darkened warning ink for text-on-soft-surface (e.g. add a warningForeground token around hsl(35,55%,38%) / #8A6A2E) and apply it to getPlaceStatusTone's text and the sync label, keeping the amber only for the accent rail/border. This preserves the warm look while clearing AA.

improvements.location: ActionButton (Start audit / Continue draft / View report)
improvements.issue: ActionButton renders a bare Tamagui Button with no height/size prop, so it relies on Tamagui's default sizing instead of layout.buttonHeight (52 on phone) defined in responsive-layout-tokens.ts. The buttons look adequately tall (~44px) in the screenshots, but bypass the shared sizing token the rest of the app standardizes on.
improvements.suggestion: Set height={layout.buttonHeight} (or the appropriate compact token) on the Button so CTAs match the documented control height and stay consistent across phone/tablet.
improvements.evidence: places.tsx:399-423 (no height prop); responsive-layout-tokens.ts:809 buttonHeight 52 phone

improvements.issue: getResponsiveContentContainerStyle is called without topInset, so the route does not add useSafeAreaInsets().top itself; top clearance instead depends on the root Stack contentStyle paddingTop:20 (app/_layout.tsx:1378) plus contentInsetAdjustmentBehavior='automatic'. It renders fine here (title clears the Dynamic Island in 05-places.png), but the helper explicitly supports topInset for notch clearance and this screen leaves it to global padding.
improvements.suggestion: Pass topInset={insets.top} (with includeTopPadding) for an explicit, device-correct top gap rather than depending on the fixed 20px Stack padding.
improvements.evidence: places.tsx:74-77 (no topInset); responsive-layout.ts:619-627 topInset doc; app/_layout.tsx:1376-1379 paddingTop:20

improvements.issue: The three summary tiles use flex={1} with style.minWidth 102 inside a flexWrap='wrap' XStack. On this device they fit one row, but on the narrowest phones or at large fontScale the 102px floor plus gap could force a tile to wrap to a second line.
improvements.suggestion: Confirm 3x102 + 2 gaps fits the smallest supported width at max fontScale, or reduce minWidth slightly so wrapping never produces a lone tile.
improvements.evidence: places.tsx:98-106 XStack flexWrap='wrap'; places.tsx:352-354 SummaryTile minWidth:102; 05-places.png shows all three on one row

tamagui_notes: Screen correctly consumes the shared primitives: ScaledParagraph/ScaledText imported as Paragraph/Text (places.tsx:15) and used throughout, matching design_system_components_used; no hand-rolled raw tamagui Text/Paragraph for body copy.
Spacing uses Tamagui $space tokens (gap '$4'/'$3', p '$4'/'$3', px '$3') consistently; radii pull from designSystem.radii rather than magic numbers (places.tsx:161,189,220).
Colors are pulled from the resolved designSystem palette (useDesignSystem) rather than hardcoded hex, so light/dark and accessibility prefs propagate (places.tsx:29, 82-118).
platform_notes: Safe-area top: 'My Audits' clears the Dynamic Island in 05-places.png via the root Stack paddingTop:20 + contentInsetAdjustmentBehavior='automatic'; the route itself does not pass insets.top (see route-omits-top-inset).

Home indicator / tab bar: bottomPadding:132 (places.tsx:75) plus the tab bar's safe-area-aware paddingBottom (responsive-layout.ts:710, getResponsiveTabBarLayout adds insets.bottom) keeps the last card clear of the home indicator in 06-places-list.png.

Thumb reach: primary 'Start audit' CTAs sit low within each card and are duplicated per item, so a primary action is always reachable in the lower portion of the screen without a single hard-to-reach top-corner CTA.
not_assessable: Exact WCAG contrast ratios (estimated from token hex over translucent soft surfaces; the amber pair is flagged as a clear-enough AA miss but the precise ratio is not measured).
Empty state (EmptyStateCard, places.tsx:431) and offline 'Online sync needed' warning banner variant are not shown in either screenshot.
Dark theme rendering and large-fontScale / dyslexic-font layout behavior (ScaledText scaling) are not in these captures.
Navigation outcomes of 'View report' / 'Start audit' (cross-screen flow to /reports/[id] and /audit/[placeId]) cannot be verified from static images.
score_rationale: Solid, design-system-consistent screen with correct primitive usage, token-based spacing/radii, and proper safe-area and tab-bar clearance on iPhone (7-8 band). Held below 9 by one real AA color-contrast miss on the amber 'NOT STARTED'/'Ready for offline capture' text and minor polish items (CTA buttons not using the responsive height token, route relying on global rather than explicit top-inset). Nothing broken or off-platform.
